upgrade_rules.description: Helm values.yaml changed; review the values.yaml diff section and update your deployment values accordingly.
Database migrations changed. Migrations run automatically on upgrade, but take a DB backup before deploying this version.
Deployment/local-install documentation or tooling changed; review updated instructions if you rely on Helm or local deployment workflows.

sections.description: 3-6 highlight-reel bullets of user-visible Hub changes. Subset of What changed, not a superset. For features and improvements, explicitly state the user/operator benefit (e.g. 'This helps …', 'So you can …'); for bug fixes, state the resolved user-facing symptom directly.
New Hub capabilities (product behavior users can do now). Each item must explicitly state the user benefit/outcome.
Bug fixes that restore or correct existing Hub behavior.
UI/UX and React / TanStack Router frontend changes (pages, components, forms, navigation).
Backend API, services, jobs, worker behavior, and backend performance/latency/reliability changes.
Helm, Docker, CI, and other deploy/infra changes (not the dependency version table).
Operator actions required on upgrade. Git rules also add Helm/migrations/docs notes; only add extra breaking/config items here.
